'''2002 Houston DPC''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG Decipher Player Championship on 14 July 2002 in Houston, Texas. [[Brian Hunter]] won. [[Justin Warren]] finished 2nd with a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list (''Raging Bull (Hoostino's Hunt Down Hammer)'').<ref name="dt-24516">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24516 Raging Bull (Hoostino's Hunt Down Hammer)], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 20 July 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24516/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24516/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009044330/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24516/ Wayback Machine].</ref> [[David Burnett]] went 2-1 with a [[Dark]] [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!]] list (''JediGamler's Watto aka The Unstoppable Machine'').<ref name="dt-24511">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24511 JediGamler's Watto aka The Unstoppable Machine], DeckTech (David "JediGambler" Burnett, 20 July 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24511/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24511/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009050306/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24511/ Wayback Machine].</ref><ref name="dpc-houston-tr">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-07-16-houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houstond3841/ houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houston], Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, DeckTech (16 July 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-07-16-houston-texas-07-14-02-dpc-houstond3841/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 14 July 2002
* '''Site:''' Houston, Texas; Strike Zone, Houston, Texas<ref name="tr-d3865" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
